headline: PAC-MAN learned to escalate
lede: The maze now speeds up as your score climbs, ghosts crawl through the warp tunnels, the HUD fruit marks your round (a late key pays 5000), and by round 14 the energizer frightens nobody — the arcade's whole progression ladder, shipped and pinned to byte-identical round 1.

notes.text: #3661 shipped via PR #3669 (791132c): score-stage speed ladder 0/700/2000/5000, tunnel-mouth crawl, round-keyed fruit with six synthesized sprites, energizer decay — laws sourced from the Wikipedia arcade article, rates pinned dice-free so ?seed=N replays hold.

Proof: pacmancheck 102/0 (+30 §progression), 31/31 mutants dead, new pacprogressiondrive 12/12 on real Chrome (HUD cherry→galaxian→key paint matched against the live probe). One mutant survived its first pass — my own DebugKit button squatting on a bare round++ regex — caught and pinned harder.

Honest-ladder audit: idle-kick ranked CENTIPEDE weakest on three struck-through shipped gaps — parseGaps ignores the repo's ~~ closed-marker. Filed #3672 with the fix; the pick this session went to the true weakest title (PAC-MAN) via recompute.
QA follow-ups filed as #3667 — intermission briefs (gap 0's remaining feature), per-kind eat jingles, stage-lift tell, phone legibility of the new HUD icon.
